description: Free-Space Optical Communication transmits data wirelessly using visible or infrared light, including LiFi and VLC. It offers high bandwidth and strong spatial reuse but depends heavily on line of sight, blockage, and accurate optical alignment.

featured.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Trajectory Design and Two-Stage Resource Management in CoMP UAV VLC Networks

featured.summary: Explores “Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Trajectory Design and Two-Stage Resource Management in CoMP UAV VLC Networks”. Focus: data-driven prediction, control, optimization or adaptation in Free-Space Optical Comm, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
